description: This file defines a custom exception class 'XliffFileProcessFailedException' within the 'OrangeHRM\Admin\Exception' namespace. The class provides static methods to create specific exception instances related to XLIFF file processing errors.

classes.name: XliffFileProcessFailedException
classes.description: A custom exception class for handling errors related to XLIFF file processing within the HRM system.

methods.name: validationFailed
methods.description: Creates an exception indicating the XLIFF file is invalid.

methods.name: emptyFile
methods.description: Creates an exception indicating the XLIFF file is empty.

methods.name: missingTargetLanguage
methods.description: Creates an exception indicating the target language attribute is missing in the XLIFF file.

methods.name: invalidTargetLanguage
methods.description: Creates an exception indicating the target language does not match the expected language.
